extracted.intended_audience: up-and-coming stand-up comedians, comedy industry professionals (agents, scouts, bookers) and entertainment news readers
extracted.subtask_short: selecting New Faces comedy festival comedians
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and reporting about the Just For Laughs 'New Faces of Comedy' showcases — categories, format, and the role the program plays as a launchpad for emerging stand-up and comedy creators. Useful for performers preparing submissions or industry members evaluating talent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — top up-and-coming / rising stand-up comedians
rubrics_metrics.description: The Just For Laughs Comedy Festival has unveiled its list of top up-and-coming comedians ... The event is a traditional launch pad for major Hollywood talent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied criterion: performers considered are 'up-and-coming' or 'rising' stand-up/comedy talent seeking industry exposure and career advancement. Target performers are those early in their career trajectory who can benefit from discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to draw laughter from a live club audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Young hopefuls eyeing Hollywood development deals grab the microphone at Just For Laughs in Montreal to draw laughter from a club audience as Los Angeles talent scouts, comedy agents and managers, TV execs and club bookers look on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical performance standard: material and delivery must elicit laughter in a live club setting while industry decision-makers observe. Demonstrable live-response impact is a key evaluative dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role as an industry launchpad / milestone
rubrics_metrics.description: The success of their careers makes New Faces the industry’s biggest coming-out party for rising stand-up talent serious business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection and presentation are evaluated with an eye to industry potential — ability to attract development deals, representation, TV opportunities. Prestige and track record of alumni underscore the program's purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Showcase format and context — Montreal, multi-day festival, industry-attended
rubrics_metrics.description: Over three days, seven New Faces categories will be showcased in Montreal with shows hosted by ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural/format criterion: performances occur in-person over multiple days in Montreal, presented to club audiences and industry attendees. Applicants/performers should prepare sets appropriate for that context (concise, club-ready, timed).

rubrics_metrics.name: New Faces of Comedy 1 & 2 (general stand-up showcases)
rubrics_metrics.description: 1. The New Faces of Comedy 1 & 2 — [list of performers: Fumi Abe, Darius Bennett, Troy Bond, Zach Brazão, Tommy Brennan, Nico Carney, Morgan Jay, Dan LaMorte, Leslie Liao, Sam Morrison, Chike Robinson, Kelly Ryan, Brittany Schmitt, Anna Seregina, Sahib Singh, Sahana Srinivasan, Derrick Stroup, Audrey Stewart, Saul Trujillo, Asha Ward, Maggie Winters].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for general stand-up performers; indicates multiple distinct showcase slots (1 & 2). Being placed here implies performer fits the standard stand-up showcase format.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Faces: Characters (Improvisation)
rubrics_metrics.description: 2. New Faces: Characters (Improvisation) — [Chris Cafero, Parker Callahan, Carl Foreman Jr., Chris Kleckner, Evan Mills, Hannah Pilkes, Laura Ramoso, Susan Song, Chloe Troast].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category specifically for character-based comedy and improvisational performers. Selection favors artists whose work centers on characters and improv techniques rather than straight stand-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Faces: Unrepped (performers without representation)
rubrics_metrics.description: 3. New Faces: Unrepped — [Clara Blackstone, Liz Blanc, Aldo Campana, Aminah Imani, Ibhan Kulkarni, Neill Lynskey, Max Manticof, Lukas McCrary, Wellington Ojukwu, Bianca Parato].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category reserved for comedians who are currently unrepresented (no agent/manager). Signals a pathway for unsigned talent to gain industry attention.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Faces: Canada (Canadian performers)
rubrics_metrics.description: 4. New Faces: Canada — [Spencer Adamus, Brendan D’Souza, Michelle Forrester, Dakota Ray Hebert, Faris Hytiaa, Moe Ismail, Maddy Kelly, Natasha Lyn Myles, Henry Sir, Ryan Williams].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for Canadian comedians; geographic/jurisdictional grouping emphasizing national talent and likely celebrating local/regional scenes.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Faces: International (non-Canadian / global performers)
rubrics_metrics.description: 5. New Faces: International — [Ceyla AB, Brennan Reece, Katie Boyle, Abhay NadkKarni, Sarah Keyworth, Glenn Moore, James Roque, Amy Gledhill, Emmanuel Sonubi, Tom Walker].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for international performers outside the Canadian cohort; selection reflects a global talent-scouting remit and diversity of comedic traditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Faces: Creators (digital/content creators)
rubrics_metrics.description: 6. New Faces: Creators — [Caroline Baniewicz, Cliff Benfield, Heather Chelan, Devin Gant, Leo González, Hayley Morris].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category oriented toward creators (likely those known for digital content, sketch/ideas creation, or multi-platform work). Selection favors performers with creator/producer credentials or non-traditional stand-up backgrounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visibility to industry decision-makers as an implicit selection goal
rubrics_metrics.description: With the massive impact of virtual entertainment, the unique opportunity for everyone from undiscovered talent to industry decision-makers to be in the same room is quite remarkable,” Bruce Hills, Just For Laughs president, said.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied evaluative dimension: programs are structured to maximize visibility and networking potential; performers are assessed on readiness to capitalize on in-person industry exposure (pitchability, marketability, professionalism).
